name: Apollo
description: Find people in Apollo by title, place and company size for free, then reveal work emails only when you say so. Shows your credit balance.
author: idayley

secrets.name: api-key
secrets.label: Apollo API key
secrets.help: In Apollo: Settings → Integrations → API. A master key also lets Wibble show your credit balance.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Apollo for people. Free: spends no credits and returns no emails. All filters are optional; page starts at 1 and each page holds up to 100 people.

person_locations.description: Where the person lives, e.g. ["United States"].

tools.name: credits
tools.description: Read the Apollo credit balance and when it resets. Free. Needs a master API key.
